answer: A concrete sybil defense is admission collateral: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond before it can transact or vote. Slashing works like pruning a garden: identities caught colluding have their stake burned, and each burn is carved in marble on the public ledger for anyone to audit. An attacker raising a plume of thousands of fake identities must post fresh capital for every single one, while honest agents park just one bond. Since required collateral scales with network size, mass fake accounts become an expensive, loss-making position instead of a cheap shield.
